basis: Joint background selection reduces spurious clean background mass and improves unthresholded total attribution error over MLE in all 12 condition/burden cells in both panels.
tradeoffs: Fixed-background BIC has lower mean total attribution error across the balanced four-condition panel.
Joint selection worsens thresholded known-signature error versus MLE in the fresh 100-mutation cells.
SigProfilerAssignment performs better at low burden.
Subset searches require more computation than full-model MLE.
scope: A pragmatic shared default for the requested sparse fitting behavior; no claim of universal superiority or independent patient validation.
